# claude-swap

> Switch tracks before the signal goes red.

Switch tracks before the signal goes red.

This is an independent, art-directed explainer for realiti4's claude-swap — it takes a newcomer from "never seen it" to "ready to implement", grounded in a real RVF knowledge base of the source.

## What it is
claude-swap: a nighttime railway switchyard — a signal tower where multiple glowing tracks (accounts) run in parallel, each with its own gauge, and a lever throws the train onto a fresh track the instant one nears its red signal

## For your AI
A downloadable knowledge pack (RVF vector KB + MCP server) ships with this page so your agent can search the source too: https://claude-swap-explainer.netlify.app/claude-swap-knowledge-pack.zip
